note: The Library. Level 1 (`l1`: the screen `library`, state `all`) answers "how far have I come, and where?": every species of the catalogue in its state (unmet, met or found) on one grid, the wish's species and the species with looks new this visit marked, and the door to one species. Level 2 (`library.species`) and Level 3 (`library.family`) are not built yet: the frame draws `library.species` with its notBuilt composition. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; a cell's parts are offsets from the cell's origin. The face reads every rect, colour and picture id here; the props name what, never where.

screens.library.species: Level 2, one species: not built yet (frame.json notBuilt)

stage.draw: kit_stage: the flat ground, then the master over it once the host has sent it

grid.rule: cell i at x = 16 + 168 * (i mod 6), y = 57 + 168 * floor(i / 6), for S01 to S16 in species-number order; the form's first, pitch and grid are its cols, rows, cell, gap and origin as kit_tiles reads them (listPitch). Level 1 always shows the whole catalogue; another catalogue size is refused and comes back to UI/UX

cell.orderNote: the node order is fixed per cell, in this order, for all 16 cells; a part a state does not show is a node of no size (the dashed rule, hidden, keeps its box with no ops: kit_hairline's hidden form)

picture.when: found: the specimen grown as found; met: its pencil study; unmet: none

face.when: found, when faceOf is not null

wish.when: found or met, on the wished species; at `rect` with the face chip, at `alone` without

glint.when: found, with at least one look new this visit; kit_glint at kit_glint_level (16 levels over 2 s; solid under reduced motion)

cell.complete: a complete species shows a full specimen and no badge

cell.enabled: met and found cells only: an unmet cell is not a target, so the pad skips it

focus.initial: Home's species (from Home's Library bezel), the guide's species (from "Open the guide") or ui.lib.l1 (the Library room key); a species that is not a target gives the first target in species order; with none met there is no ring and ✓ does nothing
focus.memory: ui.lib.l1 = the species of the ring (host UI state)

keys.confirm: on a met or found cell: "Open {species}", to library.species (Level 2, not built yet: the frame's notBuilt composition); ← there returns to Level 1 with the ring on that species
keys.back: Home, the ring on Home's Library bezel

line.subject: strings.subjects
line.slots: the frame's bottom line: action 16 to 392, the subject centred on 512 (at most 208 px and 6 words), the back room 68 px; every ✓ is named in the action slot; no digits

strings.subjectsNote: n is the looks new this visit across every species: one is "a new look"; two to six spell n (words.mjs); seven or more drop the count; none is empty; with no species met the subject is strings.subjects.none

every.pick: the first tier whose rows hold every trait group, a group never split across rows

seen: newLooksOf (specimen-props.mjs) is the one definition of a new look for Home and Level 1. Entering the Library (a library or library.* screen from outside) notes every species' guide looks in chapters not shut (ui.lib.pending, unsaved); leaving it (the first screen that is neither library nor library.*) adds the note to st.libSeen and saves. Nothing is recorded on entry or inside the Library

faces.id: face:{mibi}:{size}, with :faded when that mibi is released
faces.rule: each size is rendered straight from the mibi's own picture (the layered stand's variant for its drawn looks) through the species' face window onto libGround; a 1 px libLine frame, the fog corner ticks at 40, 56 and 64 only; :faded is round(0.38 p + 0.62 libGround) per sRGB channel, frame included; opaque. Never one size faded and scaled to another. A species with no layered stand gets a labelled stand-in

windows._note: the art director's face windows, [x, y, side] in the 304 x 312 art's pixels, a square, transparent where it passes the art's edge (the layered stands only)
